build_mlx_model_runner: build an MlxModelRunner instance to load an MLX model on Apple Silicon with configurable pool size and radix cache
prefill_request_tokens: prefill a request with new token IDs and return the next predicted token ID using prefix slot matching
decode_batch_tokens: decode one token per request in a batch using the MlxModelRunner with batched or single-request attention
extend_request_tokens: extend a chunked request by continuing prefill and syncing new KV cache to the shared pool
clear_request_states: clear all active request states and release cached KV buffers back to the pool
